provenance.base: DP2/sim copied once (working tree 2026-10-04, test_sim.py 12 tests OK, includes the QA5 `ntiers` option). Each scenario implemented in a separate copy and diffed against it; patches in results/data/qa4_patches/S*.diff, smoke scripts smoke_s*.py in the same folder.
provenance.loc_rule: added (+) lines in diff -u that are neither blank nor comment-only; a modified line counts once as its + line.
provenance.module_size_loc: AST span (function/class) or marker span LOC of the touched component in the pristine base; approximates how much an agent must read.
provenance.attribution: explicit regex rules in sim/qa4_count.py (unmatched lines abort). Injection wiring (S3 Sim.__init__ line) is attributed to the injected component; counting it as a separate composition-root module would add +1 module to both candidates.
provenance.minimality: S4: a validator-only change leaks (99 dispatches to the degraded node, the sync re-plan view lacks the flag); a planner-view-only change passes. The Plan Validator hunk is therefore optional defense-in-depth and not counted (C2 count = planner ledger view). S1: TIERS/OFFLOAD/ALLOC_ORDER edits were dropped as unnecessary after smoke passed without them.
